overview: Spooky Kart is a Halloween racer on Haunted Hollow for up to eight drivers. Eight character-and-kart combinations provide distinct handling and signature perks, from faster drift charging to temporary phasing. Play offline against bots or race friends online with bots filling empty grid places.
rules: Race Haunted Hollow with a selected driver; each driver has distinct kart handling and one perk.
Hold drift through a corner, then release to boost.
Use your driver’s perk to create advantages or disrupt rivals.
Offline races use bots, and online servers fill empty slots with bots.
controls: W/S gas/brake; A/D steers; Shift drifts; Space uses perk.
Controller: RT/A gas, LT brake, left stick steer, either bumper drift, X perk.
A/D and Enter navigate menus; P/controller Y opens Play Online; Escape/Start pauses.
story: Eight Halloween drivers compete in Haunted Hollow. No narrative campaign beyond the racing setting is documented.

characters.name: Vampire
characters.description: Fast acceleration; Bat Boost charges drifts faster and boosts harder.
characters.image_caption: A Halloween race with the Mummy, Scarecrow, Ghost and Vampire drivers.

characters.name: Frankenstein’s Monster
characters.description: Heavy, high top speed; Ram launches lighter karts during fast collisions.
characters.image_caption: Monster and their kart on the driver-selection podium.

characters.name: Mummy
characters.description: Sharp handling; Bandage Trail slows following karts.
characters.image_caption: Mummy and the Sarcophagus Sprinter in the driver selection lobby.

characters.name: Ghost
characters.description: Light, floaty kart; Phase bypasses karts, hazards and grass.
characters.image_caption: A Halloween race with the Mummy, Scarecrow, Ghost and Vampire drivers.

characters.name: Scarecrow
characters.description: Balanced kart; Crow Swarm slows the nearest kart ahead.
characters.image_caption: A Halloween race with the Mummy, Scarecrow, Ghost and Vampire drivers.

characters.name: Zombie
characters.description: Sturdy, slow kart; Undead reduces grass and stun penalties.
characters.image_caption: Zombie and their kart on the driver-selection podium.

characters.name: Clown
characters.description: Tight-turning kart; Honk pushes nearby karts away.
characters.image_caption: Clown and their kart on the driver-selection podium.

characters.name: Skeleton
characters.description: Light, quick acceleration; Rattle drops spin-inducing bones.
characters.image_caption: Skeleton and their kart on the driver-selection podium.
